_about: Where frontier runs have actually lost (kind loss), named an assumption and waved it through (kind named_assumption), or made a move unprompted (kind reflex). effort.py reads it: every result the careful but hurried pass grades Missed or Partly cites at least one loss or named_assumption id whose class matches the kind of move the result prices; an uncited cell is graded Right, because a paper estimate with no run behind it came back 40 to 60 points high in every Sulfur round (38.4 measured about 97, 46.5 about 95, 16.2 about 73, 46.7 about 70). A reflex is priced Right in the careful column whatever the design says. Sources are the Sulfur run record (stumping/references/sulfur-record.md and each task's runs/), the client's depth scale with its task detail (guidelines/client/depth-scale-2026-11-09-detail.md) and the example library (guidelines/client/examples/). A new id is added only from a run or a client page, never from a design.
